text: Call Issued: December 19, 2017 Call Closed: January 26, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: Two (2) Number of Bids: One (1) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for Request for Proposal 9117-17-7100 Proponent Name Galcon Marine Ltd.

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the revised report (April 5, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Proposal 9117-17-7100 Description: Provision of Design/Build/Execute services to clean the Island Water Treatment Plant's three (3) deep water intakes using pigging/swabbing techniques. Recommended Bidder or Proponent: Galcon Marine Ltd. Contract Award Value: $3,998,627 net of all applicable taxes and charges $4,507,149 including HST and all applicable charges $4,058,827 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start from the date of award and be completed by January 31, 2020.
